stem: A humidity sensor mounted directly in the discharge stream of a dehumidifier reads much drier than sensors distributed through the crop canopy. What should be done first?
choices: Increase humidification for the entire room immediately
Treat the discharge reading as the crop average
Evaluate sensor placement and compare it with representative canopy measurements before changing set points
rationale: A sensor in a conditioned-air discharge can sample a local microclimate. Placement and representative canopy measurements should be checked before changing room controls.
